name: zfmv_action_image_scalar_deleting_destructor
description: zFMV_ActionImage::ScalarDeletingDestructor calls the image action destructor, conditionally invokes operator delete when bit 0 of flags is set, and returns this.
known_limits: Tier C only; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zFMV image action/source-file pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation for 0x4631d0 validates the MSVC scalar deleting destructor shape: save this, call zFMV_ActionImage::Destructor, test flags bit 0, call operator delete only when set, return the original this pointer, and clean the flags argument with ret 4.
The native smoke verifies that the wrapper returns self, runs destructor side effects, and calls the operator delete provider exactly once when flags bit 0 is set.
